mapper.insert: insert into notification(user_id, type, title, content, related_id, is_read, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedId}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, type, title, content, related_id, is_read, create_time from notification where user_id = #{userId} order by is_read asc, create_time desc
select count(*) from notification where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
mapper.update: update notification set is_read = 1 where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update notification set is_read = 1 where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
mapper.delete: delete from notification where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
